Target company: Meta Platforms (META). Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and related social products; advertising is a major business activity. It also develops virtual and augmented reality products.

Focal announcement: For Those Using Metaverse Technologies, the Impact Is Real.

Decision cutoff: 2023-09-07T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: For Those Using Metaverse Technologies, the Impact Is Real. Published date: 2023-09-07. URL: https://about.fb.com/news/2023/09/impact-of-vr-and-ar.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Imagine if doctors could practice surgery in a realistic, risk-free way – with virtual reality (VR) that’s already possible and happening today. Today, we’re sharing some examples of how people and businesses around the world are using these immersive technologies and the tangible impact they’re having. “With more than 5 billion people worldwide lacking access to safe surgery due in part to a shortage of trained surgeons, the ability to train in a safe and accessible environment can make a significant impact in countries where access to advanced surgical training is limited. The positive impact of immersive technologies is already apparent, and as metaverse technologies continue to progress, we expect even more opportunities will emerge to maximize the benefits of these innovations. See more about how people are using metaverse technologies today .
